# Libre Computer GPIO Pinout

> Interactive GPIO pinout and pinmux reference for Libre Computer single-board computers.

Part of Libre Computer (https://libre.computer/llms.txt). Every board page carries its pin table as HTML.

## Boards

- [Tritium H3](https://gpio.hardware.libre.computer/all-h3-cc-h3/): 7J1, 40 pins: 28 with a GPIO line; functions I2C, SPI, UART, PCM, SPDIF, JTAG; also 2J3 (3 pins)
- [Tritium H5](https://gpio.hardware.libre.computer/all-h3-cc-h5/): 7J1, 40 pins: 28 with a GPIO line; functions I2C, SPI, UART, PCM, SPDIF, JTAG; also 2J3 (3 pins)
- [Alta](https://gpio.hardware.libre.computer/aml-a311d-cc/): 7J1, 40 pins: 28 with a GPIO line; functions I2C, SPI, UART, PWM, SPDIF, SDIO, JTAG; also 2J1 (3 pins)
- [Alta Compute Module](https://gpio.hardware.libre.computer/aml-a311d-cm/): J1, 100 pins: 52 with a GPIO line; functions I2C, SPI, UART, PWM, SPDIF, JTAG; also J2 (100 pins)
- [La Frite](https://gpio.hardware.libre.computer/aml-s805x-ac/): 7J1, 40 pins: 28 with a GPIO line; functions I2C, SPI, UART, PWM, I2S, PCM, SPDIF, SDIO, JTAG; also 2J2 (4 pins), 9J5 (4 pins)
- [Das Frite](https://gpio.hardware.libre.computer/aml-s805x-ac-v2/): 7J1, 40 pins: 28 with a GPIO line; functions I2C, SPI, UART, PWM, I2S, PCM, SPDIF, SDIO, JTAG; also 2J2 (4 pins)
- [Solitude](https://gpio.hardware.libre.computer/aml-s905d3-cc/): 7J1, 40 pins: 28 with a GPIO line; functions I2C, SPI, UART, PWM, SPDIF, SDIO, JTAG; also 2J1 (3 pins)
- [Solitude Compute Module](https://gpio.hardware.libre.computer/aml-s905d3-cm/): J1, 100 pins: 52 with a GPIO line; functions I2C, SPI, UART, PWM, SPDIF, JTAG; also J2 (100 pins)
- [Le Potato](https://gpio.hardware.libre.computer/aml-s905x-cc/): 7J1, 40 pins: 28 with a GPIO line; functions I2C, SPI, UART, PWM, I2S, PCM, SPDIF, SDIO; also 2J3 (8 pins), 2J1 (3 pins), 9J1 (3 pins)
- [Sweet Potato](https://gpio.hardware.libre.computer/aml-s905x-cc-v2/): 7J1, 40 pins: 28 with a GPIO line; functions I2C, SPI, UART, PWM, I2S, PCM, SPDIF, SDIO; also 2J3 (8 pins), 2J1 (3 pins), 9J2 (3 pins)
- [Renegade](https://gpio.hardware.libre.computer/roc-rk3328-cc/): J1, 40 pins: 28 with a GPIO line; functions I2C, SPI, UART, PWM, I2S, SPDIF; also J21 (3 pins), J22 (3 pins)
- [Renegade Elite](https://gpio.hardware.libre.computer/roc-rk3399-pc/): J12, 30 pins: 7 with a GPIO line; functions I2C, SPI; also J15 (30 pins), J20 (30 pins), J21 (30 pins), J1 (6 pins), J6 (6 pins), J13 (3 pins)
